newsitem.title: USA: Bonneville Pacific Corp says in settlement.
newsitem.headline: Bonneville Pacific Corp says in settlement.

text.p: Bonneville Pacific Corp, through its Chapter 11 bankruptcy trustee Roger Segal, said Tuesday it reached a settlement for payment of $985,000 from Terry Coffin and related parties.
The company said the settlement provides that privately owned Bonneville Pacific and its bankruptcy estate will waive and release all claims against the Coffin parties in exchange for the payment.
The settlement is conditioned on approval by U.S. Bankruptcy Court, the company said. Although the Coffin parties agreed to the settlement, they denied allegations of wrongdoing, the company said.
